_about: What a launched body does to buildings (docs/world/destruction-hook.md, docs/design/buildings.md; WorldBrunt). tierFactor: the damage a body does a building is its normalised speed x tierFactor[tier] x bruntMul. chainMax: links a flight may use by tier 1 to 4 (a tower is one, a house houseLink); chainSpecial: a finisher's. towerPunches: the towers a flight may go through by tier; a tower beyond it holds the body (a wall), unless the floors it covers have already taken giveWay times their own strength in damage (the building remembers its walls: wallMemory of the damage taken is taken off a floor's strength, to at least wallMin of it). Tier 1 holds at 0: raise towerPunches[0] to 1 and a tier-1 hit goes through one tower (Orb's question: does a tower hold early on). heldDeathShare: the most of a held floor's people a hit kills. houseKeep: the speed kept through a house; keepHi, keepK, keepRef, keepMin: the speed kept through a punched floor (keepHi - keepK x strength / keepRef, between keepMin and keepHi); keepFree: through floors already gone; heavyKeep: a heavy wreck. lodgeSeconds: the last building of a chain takes what is left (lodgeDump of it as one more hit on its core) and holds the body this many seconds, by tier; lodgeSpecialSeconds a finisher's; specialTier: a finisher reads as at least this tier. The wall slam: a body held at a wall takes wallSlamMul times the hit (Game Design: twice) and is staggered wallStaggerTicks. lodgeHold: does a lodge or a wall hold the whole sim (world, a hit-stop) or only the body (body: he is stunned and the fight goes on): Orb's homework. The chain inside a tower (buildings.md section 7.3, ruled 2026-10-17; WorldInterior): interiorChain 0 off or 1 on; interiorTanMin and interiorTanMax the send's angle (tangents of 15 and 60 degrees); interiorCeilKeep and interiorFloorKeep the speed kept through a ceiling and through a slab or face that breaks; interiorMaxContacts and interiorMaxBounces the caps (no bounce is produced yet); interiorFaceStop the entry face's stop in ticks; interiorCapSeconds the ragdolled time from the face; interiorCeilTier the effective tier that reaches the ceiling; interiorExitTier the tier whose far face breaks; interiorHurt the share of a hit's damage a slab does him.
